channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Demirtaş sentenced to over 1 year in prison for insulting president
item.description: A court in the southern province of Mersin on Jan. 6 sentenced former Peoples’ Democratic Party (HDP) co-chair Selahattin Demirtaş to one year and five months in prison on charges of insulting the president.

item.title: Erdoğan discusses Venezuela attack with Trump on phone
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan expressed Türkiye's concerns regarding the U.S. military operation in Venezuela and the capture of President Nicolás Maduro during a phone conversation with U.S. President Donald Trump.

item.title: Terror-free Türkiye to establish new regional geopolitics: Intelligence chief
item.description: Türkiye’s intelligence chief, İbrahim Kalın, has said that the success of the terror-free Türkiye project will establish new regional geopolitics, vowing Ankara’s efforts to eliminate terrorism and its financial roots will intensify in the coming period.

item.title: A new Grammy category honors album covers
item.description: The Grammy Awards are introducing a standalone category honoring best album cover for the first time in more than 50 years, highlighting the creative power of visual storytelling in the digital music era.

item.title: Türkiye-UK trade volume could reach $70 billion: Association
item.description: Trade between Türkiye and the United Kingdom continued to expand in 2025, surpassing $30 billion when services are included, says Vehbi Keleş, chairman of the European Turkish Brands Association (ATMB).

item.title: Türkiye to submit bill banning social media access for under-15s by month end
item.description: Türkiye will submit a draft bill by the end of this month that would prohibit children under the age of 15 from accessing social media platforms, Family and Social Services Minister Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş has announced.

item.title: Israel to introduce electronic tagging in West Bank
item.description: The Israeli army said Monday it was introducing a new technological system to enforce movement restrictions in the occupied West Bank for both Israelis and Palestinians, in a move Israeli media said aims to rein in surging settler violence.

item.title: Trump weighs military option to acquire Greenland
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump is discussing options including military action to take control of Greenland, the White House said Tuesday, upping tensions that Denmark warns could destroy the NATO alliance.

item.title: Ukraine's European, US allies meet in Paris on security guarantees
item.description: Key European allies of Ukraine and top U.S. envoys met in Paris on Tuesday and were expected to announce Washington would lead ceasefire monitoring if a peace deal is reached to end Russia's war against its neighbour.

item.title: New Venezuela leader says 'no foreign power' running country
item.description: Venezuela's interim leader Delcy Rodriguez insisted Tuesday no foreign power was governing her country, even as U.S. President Donald Trump announced Caracas will be swiftly turning over millions of barrels of oil to the United States.
